description: This file defines authentication-related classes and methods for a Flutter web/mobile application. It includes the `AuthUser` class representing user info and the `AuthService` class providing login, logout, registration, token management, and session persistence functionalities. The implementation supports mocking for testing purposes and is designed to interact with shared preferences for local storage.

classes.name: AuthUser
classes.description: Represents an authenticated user's profile containing ID, name, and email.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Handles authentication workflows, including login, registration, token management, and user session persistence, supporting mock mode for testing.

methods.name: AuthService.create
methods.description: Asynchronous factory method to instantiate AuthService with environment-based configuration.

methods.name: AuthService.hasToken
methods.description: Checks if an authentication token exists in persistent storage.

methods.name: AuthService.getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored authentication token, if available.

methods.name: AuthService.getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the currently authenticated user's profile from storage.

methods.name: AuthService.logout
methods.description: Clears authentication data from persistent storage, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: AuthService.login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password; in mock mode, generates a dummy token and user data.

methods.name: AuthService.register
methods.description: Registers a new user; in mock mode, creates dummy user and token data.

methods.name: AuthService.requestPasswordReset
methods.description: Simulates a password reset request; in real mode, would call backend API.

methods.name: _persistSession
methods.description: Helper method to store session data (token and user info) into persistent storage.
